item.title: Aggregate reports by account and currency
item.brief: Read ledger CSV with optional currency column; if absent (legacy input), treat every row as USD. Validate any provided currency as exactly three uppercase ASCII letters; malformed currency prints an error to stderr and exits status 2. Output header account,currency,total_cents, aggregate per account and currency, sort by account then currency. Update README, run python3 -m unittest, and commit the change.

item.title: Emit validated currency in ledger CSV

Validate exactly three uppercase ASCII letters; malformed currency must print an error naming the input line number to stderr and exit status 2. Preserve status 1 for other input errors. Update README, run cargo test, and commit the change.
